notes.title: Windblown | Alterattack Update Beta
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Leapers![/h1]

So it's been a little while... 👀

We're back today with some awesome news though! We just deployed the brand new Open Beta build for our upcoming Alterattack Update.

In this new update you'll find a bunch of new additions to the game, most notably the updates name sake, the Alterattack. Let's check it out!

[list]
[*] [b]Alterattack Update[/b]: We've changed how they charge, upgrade, and reset. All of which aim to make the mechanic more strategic and impactful. Promoting aggressive playstyles.
[*] [b]Magifish Update[/b]: These now trigger with the Alterattack signal, having their durations increased with each stage.
[*] [b]New Expedition Recap Screen[/b]: See useful data like damage dealt, where that damage came from, the build you had and much more.
[*] [b]New Eperin Upgrades[/b]: Three new purchasable upgrades - Equipment Chest, Killstreak Chests, and the Backpack.
[*] [b]5 New Affixes[/b]: with effects that enchance Alterattack damage or grant Brutality, Echo, and even Overwhelm effects
[/list]

We can't wait to hear what you think of these new changes, and how they impact your experience with the game!

Fire any feedback to us via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1911610/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url], or in our [url=https://discord.gg/v4S6Vsarkx]Discord[/url]!

[h3]How to access the beta[/h3]
[list]
[*] Go to your Steam game library.
[*] Right click on Windblown and click "properties".
[*] Select the tab "Betas".
[*] In the first dropdown box select "public_beta"
[*] Click close and wait for the update to finish downloading.
[/list]

[h2]🚨Remember - This is a BETA version of the game, meaning you may encounter bugs. Make sure to duplicate your save before jumping in. That way you can revert back to the Default Branch whenever you'd like without locking yourself to the new version before its release🚨[/h2]

notes.title: Windblown | The Gift Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Leapers[/h1]

The Windblown Gift Update is [b]OUT NOW![/b]

This latest update has been a lot of work, and we're so happy to get these reworks into players hands. Gifts are a huge part of Windblown, and are responsible for shaping the [b]INSANE[/b] builds you create during a run. 

[h3]There are a couple more additions coming in this patch too, so check out our latest update trailer below![/h3]

[previewyoutube=Rj7gBnmEL3w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New Additions[/h1]

[h2]New Gifts[/h2]

We're adding some awesome new Gifts to the game! [b]17 in fact![/b] With some being brand new effects altogether! [b]Corrosion[/b] and [b]Overwhelm[/b] are making their way into the Vortex and offer some super fun new ways to bring down unsuspecting Golems!

We're also adding a bunch of new options to things like [b]Blast, Bleed, Echo, and more[/b]. Meaning you have even more freedom when it comes to builds.

You can find the full breakdown of new additions in the patch notes below 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/87af416eca9c81e3a9b7f9ee2d4287def0a8eaac.png[/img]

[h2]Reworked Gifts[/h2]

This is a big one... We took the time to look at [b]EVERY SINGLE[/b] Gift in the game, applying tweaks, changes, or in some cases reworking them altogether. With Gifts being such a big part of Windblown, it's super important that players are having a blast with the builds they make!

The applied changes also ensure that Gifts scale smoothly through your runs and into Endless Mode, making you more powerful than ever before!

[h2]Hexes[/h2]

Hexes have received a boost too, with [b]16 new ones arriving in this update![/b] You'll find reworked and upgraded options to existing Hexes, with new additions that will make some builds even more insane (spoiler alert: DoT builds just got serious... 👀).

We've also moved Hexes onto their own Inventory slot, meaning they no longer share capacity with their non-hexed counterparts. This should allow you to not only push your builds further, but not have to sacrifice a key Gift for your build because you have a Hex in play too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/c0230f77e7b21b5df6011be5a13c7bd27718acd0.png[/img]

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]

With most Windblown patches, we introduce new weapons too! And this time is no different! We're adding [b]TWO[/b] brand new weapons to the game, one of which might look familiar!

[list]
[*] [b]Impactone [/b]- A slow swinging, long reaching weapon which may look familiar to players who have ventured into the Sanctuary Biome. It's Alterattack launches two sweeping lasers which collide in the middle, devastating anything caught in their path.
[*] [b]Jar [/b]- The Jar uses the Shells you collect as ammunition, increasing in damage for every shot you fire in a chain. If you run out of Shells, you'll fire small rocks instead. Not as impactful, but they still hurt! The Alterattack fires a huge Shell which explodes on impact, firing out smaller projectiles that bounce and launch even more.
[/list]

[b]Bonus Update[/b] - The Shield has received an update! It now absorbs way more incoming damage and its parry attack deals more. The Alterattack’s ethereal shields now protect you from a hit, making it a fully defensive move. Check out the full update in the patch notes at the end of this post! 👇


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/f874cfcf6478f8be43536d559160ac567e229890.gif[/img]

[h2]Inventory Items[/h2]

Finally, we've added important items to players Inventories. This allows you to see what items or upgrades you may have picked up during your time in Windblown e.g. Banger Pulsor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/c6bf7928bd9ccf91bab546b531be2bf02c47eb37.png[/img]

That's all for this update! We want to thank everyone again for taking the time to play Windblown! We hope this overhaul of the Gift system brings even more chaos to your runs, with plenty of flexibility and freedom to make the build of your dreams!

Until next time! 

-MT

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h1]🚀 New version deployed 0.6.0 (6a0bbab5)[/h1]

[h2]Important changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]17 new Gifts[/b]
[*][b]16 new Hexes[/b]
[*][b]New weapons: Impactone [/b] [spoiler][i](to be found in Sanctuary)[/i][/spoiler] & [b]Jar[/b] [spoiler][i](to be found on "Big Jar" variant)[/i][/spoiler]
[*]⭐️ [b]Gifts have been updated[/b], rebalanced, removed, clarified or merged following player feedbacks. This update focuses on improving the current base, and we will add more Gift-related content in future updates.
[*]⭐️ Many [b]effects[/b] that had fixed values [b]now scale with your progression in the expedition[/b], and at higher difficulties. Gifts with the "Auto scaling" icon now scale with the amount of Bosses killed.
[*]Hexed Gifts have been renamed to [b]Hexes[/b]
[*]⭐️ [b]Hexes[/b]: now have [b]dedicated slots[/b] and unlock through the loyalty program of Frend.
[*]⭐️ [b]Co-op / Gift Slots[/b]: Gift slots that spawn as a door reward can now be used by every team member (instead of just one). [i]To compensate, they are now less frequent in multiplayer.[/i]
[*]⭐️ [b]Inventory Items[/b]: all the important objects collected during your adventure are now visible in your Inventory
[*]Introducing [b]Total damage[/b]. These damage bonuses are applied last, scale better and can lead to explosive results. [i]Damage calculation is done this way: 
Base x (Sum of Standard damage bonuses) x (Sum of Total damage bonuses).[/i]
[*][b]Enemies[/b]: [spoiler]Headbanger's pillars can now appear in the Factory[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]QoL[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Memory Deck[/b]: Memories that have not been discovered in your expeditions will now be obfuscated to avoid spoilers.
[*]⭐️ [b]Single Player / Inventory[/b]: opening it now pauses the game.
[*]⭐️ [b]UI[/b]: Cooldowns coming from Gifts are now feedbacked in the UI
[*][b]UI[/b]: Added a tooltip for Chained Alterattacks.
[*][b]UI[/b]: Added a tooltip for Alterattack damage bonuses.
[*][b]VFX[/b]: Bleed and Burn VFX have been massively reduced to reduce visual clutter.
[*][b]UI[/b] : Added possibility to toggle tooltips in in-world item descriptions (Drops, Shop Items, etc.)
[*][b]Timed Chests[/b]: now have a dedicated area that will appear if any player has unlocked them
[*]⭐️ [b]Crystallize[/b]: accelerated chained Crystallize with ranged weapons
[*]⭐️ [b]Accessibility[/b]: added a toggle to remove the hearbeat SFX at low health
[*]⭐️ [b]UI[/b]: simplified some affix descriptions
[*]⭐️ [b]UI[/b]: added new symbol before affixes to replace the confusing "+" sign
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Gear[/b]: Rebalanced how weapons and trinkets scale with their level.
[*][b]Biomes[/b]: [spoiler]Fungal Swamp[/spoiler] biome is now unlocked when rescuing [spoiler]Sigourney[/spoiler]
[*][b]Drops[/b]: [spoiler]Elder Sword[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Sharp Sisters[/spoiler] are now unlocked by killing [spoiler]the right "big" Naveless brother[/spoiler]
[*][b]Attack speed[/b]: Weapons are now capped at +100% attack speed outside of Endless Mode (from 60%).
[*][b]Boosts[/b]: Trinket refill changed to 10% per Boost (from 12%).
[*][b]Timed Chests[/b]: Timed Chests will no longer appear in the Incubator biome when you are not in Endless mode
[*]⭐️ [b]Economy:[/b] increased Shells dropped in Factory in Endless Mode to make sure some small robots drop some
[*]⭐️ [b]Economy[/b]: updated prices of all Encrypted Memories which were dropped in Sanctuary previously or are now dropped there
[*]⭐️ [b]Enemies[/b]: WorkerSaw (aka Pizza Cutter) last combo attack (the rotating one) hitbox reduced
[/list]

[h2]Gifts Update[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]General[/b]:
 - [b]Abundance[/b]: Bonus cogs increased to +25% (from +20%) and now applies to the whole team
 - [b]Berserk Fury[/b]: Now scales with every point of missing HP rather than every percent. To compensate, damage bonus value reduced to 0.5% (from 1%).
 - [b]Boost Stock[/b]: Clarified text to mention that the Boost drop is only when completing a room with Elites/Bosses.
 - [b]Cursed Dodge/Goo Dodge/Brutality Dodge/Focus Dodge/Frozen Dodge[/b]: Removed, but they evolved into...
   - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Enraged Dodge[/b]: Dodge activates Brutality (60% autoscaling, for 4s) and Freezes for 2s. Gain 10% chance to automatically Dodge any damage.[/spoiler]
   - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Crippling Dodge[/b]: Dodge applies Goo for 4s and 10 Curses (4% autoscaling). You also gain 10% chance to automatically Dodge any damage.[/spoiler]
 - [b]Deadly Expansion[/b]: Merged into [b]Deadly Extension[/b].
 - [b]Protection[/b]: Fixed an issue where the protection could trigger even if no damage was done. Now requires 20 kills to recharge (instead of being useable once per biome).
 - [b]Survivor[/b]: Can now be replaced and is now consumed when used. Now heals for 100% (from 50%).
 - [b]Boss Killer[/b]: Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. Value changed to 35% to compensate (from 40%).
 - [b]Duelist[/b]: Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. Value reduced to 25% to compensate (from 60%). Applies to both Weapons and Trinkets.
 - [b]Tranquility[/b]: Now only applied to Ranged Weapons. Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. Value changed to 25% to compensate (from 60%).
 - [b]Proximity[/b]: Now only applied to Melee Weapons. Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. Value changed to 35% to compensate (from 40%).
 - [b]Midas[/b]: Bonus damage changed to 4% per 100 gold (from 5%).
 - [b]Double Hits[/b]: Removed.
[*][b]Alterattack[/b]:
 - [b]Advanced Alterattacks[/b]: No longer reduces Alterattack damage.
 - [b]Super Alterattacks[/b]: Now multiplies the Alterattack bonus by 1.5.
 - [b]Brutal Alterattacks[/b]: Now multiplies the Alterattack bonus of Chained Alterattacks by 1.75.
[*][b]Blast[/b]:
 - Updated VFX.
 - Tooltip now mentions that if several Blast are launched at the same time, they merge into one.
 - Removed the unclear notion of "Direct hits", Blast now apply to more Weapon hits.
 - Blast initial size has been increased by 25%.
 - [b]Hit Blast[/b]: Renamed to [b]Explosive Hits[/b]. Now deals 20% of the initial hit's damage to the target and 60% to targets behind it (from 40% to all).
 - [b]Critical Blast[/b]: Renamed to [b]Explosive Criticals[/b]. Now deals 30% of the initial hit's damage to the target and 80% to targets behind it (from 60% to all).
 - [b]Enhanced Blast[/b]: Bonus damage is now applied to all targets, instead of only those behind the first. Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. To compensate, damage bonus value reduced from 100% to 50%. Size bonus changed to +75% (from +50%).
 - [b]Goo Blast[/b]: Size bonus changed to +75% (from +50%).
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Critical Blast[/b]: Blasts total damage +50% and they are treated as Criticals to trigger other effects.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Marked Blast[/b]: Blasts apply Mark (100 damage, cooldown: 4s, upgraded by killing bosses) and can also trigger them.[/spoiler]
[*][b]Bleed[/b]:
 - Bleed counters above enemies now feedback when the maximum amount is reached
 - When at the maximum amount of stacks, applying a stronger Bleed will now always replace a weaker one.
 - [b]Bleeding Weapons[/b]/[b]Bleeding Trinkets[/b]: Merged into [b]Bleeding Hits[/b]. Bleed damage changed to 1 autoscaling (from 1 flat for Weapons, and from 1.5 flat for Trinkets)
 - [b]Bleeding Criticals[/b]: Bleed damage changed to 1.5 autoscaling (from 1.5 flat)
 - [b]Hemorrhage[/b]: Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. Bonus damage improved to +100% (from +50%).
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Blood Boil:[/b] Applying Bleed also applies Burn (3 damage autoscaling).[/spoiler]
 - [b]Bleed Infusion[/b]: Now also applies to Trinket hits.
[*][b]Brutality[/b]:
 - Now feedbacks its current bonus damage value near its icon.
 - [b]Brutal Trinkets[/b]: Bonus damage changed to 50% autoscaling (from 60% flat).
 - [b]Brutal Alternation[/b]: Bonus damage changed to 30% autoscaling (from 40% flat).
 - [b]Deadly Brutality[/b]: Bonus damage changed to 60% autoscaling (from 60% flat).
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Brutal Dash[/b]: Dashes activate Brutality (30% autoscaling, for 1s).[/spoiler]
 - [b]Powerful Brutality[/b]: Bonus damage changed to 8% every second, autoscaling (from 10% flat).
[*][b]Burn[/b]:
 - Burn counters above enemies now feedback when the maximum amount is reached.
 - When at the maximum amount of stacks, applying a stronger Burn will now always replace a weaker one.
 - Burn damage is now told in terms of damage per tick rather than DPS. The dedicated tooltip gives the current hit frequency.
 - [b]Burning Weapons[/b]/[b]Burning Trinkets[/b]: Merged into [b]Burning Hits[/b]. Burn damage changed to 2 autoscaling (from 3 flat for Weapons, and from 4.5 flat for Trinkets)
 - [b]Burning Criticals[/b]: Burn damage changed to 3 autoscaling (from 4.5 flat)
 - [b]Deadly Burn[/b]: Removed.
 - [b]Fireball[/b]: Now applies to ALL kills, not just enemies with Burn. Burn damage changed to 2 autoscaling (from 3 flat). Now dropped by the [spoiler]Melee Ant in the Mushroom biome[/spoiler].
 - [b]Incandescent Burn[/b]: Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. Damage rate bonus changed to +50% (from +25%).
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Gory Flame:[/b] Applying Burn also applies Bleed (1.5 bonus damage, autoscaling).[/spoiler]
 - [b]Burn Infusion[/b]: Now also applies to Trinket hits.
[*][b]Corrosive[/b]:
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Corrosive[/b]: New damage type shared by several items. Corrosive damage over time apply most "on hit" effects (unlike other damage over time effects), and will always be applied for their full duration (even when launched with effects that can be resisted or degressive).[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Corrosive Pool[/b]: Area that deals Corrosive damage every 0.5s.[/spoiler]
 - [b]Destructive Trinkets[/b]: Renamed to [b]Corrosive Trinkets[/b]. Damage changed to 25 damage autoscaling per hit (from 20 flat).
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Corrosive Alterattack[/b]: Alterattacks create a Corrosive Pool (25 damage autoscaling, for 3s).[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Dissolve[/b]: Corrosive Total damage +100%.[/spoiler]
 - [b]Corrosive Goo[/b]: renamed to [b]Corrosive Control[/b]. Now also applies to Frozen targets. Damage changed to 10 autoscaling (from 10 flat), and to Corrosive. The damage duration is always the one of Goo/Freeze before any resistance/degression.
[*][b]Curse[/b]:
 - When the target has Final Curse, applying a stronger Curse will now always replace the bonus of a weaker one.
 - [b]Cursed Hits[/b]: Bonus damage changed to 3% autoscaling (from 4% flat)
 - [b]Cursed Criticals[/b] Bonus damage changed to 5% autoscaling (from 6% flat)
 - [b]Deadly Curse[/b]: Removed.
[*][b]Echo[/b]:
 - Echo is now an effect with a tooltip.
 - Replication delay reduced to 0.5s (from 0.7s), this should make the base effect useable with a bit more weapons.
 - Echo should now correctly apply hit effects.
 - [b]Echo[/b]: renamed to [b]Echoing Hits[/b]. Now only applied to Weapon and Trinket hits, to avoid other effects overriding the replication.
 - [b]Spread Echo[/b]: Visuals changed, and now also deals damage to the original target.
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Swift Echo[/b]: Echo replication delay -0.2s.[/spoiler]
[*][b]Freeze[/b]:
 - Shattering freeze now deals Total damage.
 - [b]Intense Freeze[/b]: Upgraded to Total damage.
[*][b]Focus[/b]:
 - Focus has been removed, as its effects are too similar to Brutality. We prefer to expand on Brutality effects rather than having the two coexist.
 - [b]Focused Dash/Focused Trinkets/Strong Focus/Heavy Focus[/b]: Removed.
[*][b]Goo[/b]:
 - [b]Cruel Goo[/b]: Upgraded to Total damage.
[*][b]Mark[/b]:
 - [b]Random Mark[/b]: Damage changed to 125 autoscaling (from 100 flat)
 - [b]Dash Mark[/b]: Damage changed to 50 autoscaling (from 50 flat)
 - [b]Trinket Mark[/b]: Damage changed to 100 autoscaling (from 100 flat)
 - [b]Spread Mark/Duplicated Mark[/b]: Merge into a new [b]Spread Mark[/b] that also deals damage to the original target.
 - [b]Double Mark[/b]: Removed.
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Burning Mark[/b]: Triggering a Mark applies 5 Burn (3 damage each, autoscaling).[/spoiler]
[*][b]Overwhelm[/b]:
 - Overwhelm is a new effect. Hits that Overwhelm deal +125% Total damage.
 - [b]Assassinate[/b]: Reworked. Now the first hit against a target is a guaranteed Overwhelm, and gives +25% chance to Overwhelm for 2s (stackable).
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Sneaky[/b]: Backstabs give +30% chance to Overwhelm.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Overwhelming Hits[/b]: Hits have a 5% chance to Overwhelm.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Overwhelming Dash[/b]: Dashes give 20% chance to Overwhelm with Weapons and Trinkets for 1s.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Overwhelming Afflictions[/b]: Every Burn, Bleed and Curse stack on a target gives 1% chance to Overwhelm with Weapons and Trinkets against this target (Final Curse counts as 10 stacks).[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Overpower[/b]: Overwhelm deals an additional +125% Total damage.[/spoiler]
[*][b]Rush[/b]:
 - [b]Alterattack Rush[/b]: renamed to [b]Rush Alterattacks[/b]. Damage changed to 150 autoscaling (from 150 flat).
 - [b]Rush Trinkets[/b]: Damage changed to 150 autoscaling (from 150 flat).
 - [b]Damage Rush[/b]: Removed.
 - [b]Powerful Rush[/b]: Upgraded to Total damage.
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Double Rush[/b]: Rush can now be used twice in a row.[/spoiler]
[*][b]Scythe[/b]:
 - Scythe damage is now told in terms of damage per hit rather than DPS. The dedicated tooltip gives the current hit frequency.
 - Base hit frequency changed to 0.5s (from 0.33s) to compensate for other changes.
 - [b]Damage Scythe/Trinket Scythe[/b]: Damage now autoscales.
 - [b]Deadly Scythe[/b]: Damage now autoscales. Value changed to 15 per hit (from 10).
 - [b]Extended Scythe[/b]: Bonus duration improved to 100% (from 50%).
 - [b]Merged Scythe[/b]: Bonus damage upgraded to Total damage. And a new VFX!
 - [b]Powerful Scythe[/b]: Bonus damage upgraded to Total damage.
[*][b]Hexes[/b]:
- Hex givers now appear more randomly during your expeditions, instead of always at the beginning of a biome.
- Hexes can now all be replaced and dropped.
 - [b]Barrier Hex/Future Hex/Present Hex[/b]: Removed.
 - [b]Weapon Hex[/b]: Reworked. Weapon total damage +50% but Trinket total damage -50%.
 - [b]Trinket Hex[/b]: Reworked. Trinket total damage +50% but Weapon total damage -50%.
 - [b]Speed Hex[/b]: Now uses Total damage.
 - [b]Critical Hex[/b]: Now uses Total damage.
 - [b]Damage Hex/Healing Hex/Lifesteal Hex/Velocity Hex[/b]: Removed, but their effects come back into...
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Random Trade Hex:[/b] Get a random positive effect in exchange of a random negative effect.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Random Chrysalis Hex:[/b] Get a random negative effect. In 25 enemy kills, it transforms into a random positive effect.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Random Eroding Hex:[/b] Get a random positive effect. Every kill reduces the value of the effect.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Power Blast Hex:[/b] Blasts total damage +100% but they can no longer apply Bleed, Burn or Curse.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Affliction Blast Hex:[/b] Blasts add 1 bonus stack when they apply Bleed, Burn or Curse, but -90% to their total damage.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Affliction Hex:[/b] Bleed and Burn total damage +100% but all other total damage -50%.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Brutality Hex:[/b] Brutality bonus x1.5 but total damage -50% if Brutality is not active.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Pool Hex:[/b] Corrosive Pools hit frequency +100% but size -50%.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Curse Hex:[/b] Final Curse total bonus multiplier +1 but duration divided by 2 for the team.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Echo Hex:[/b] Echo deals +100% total damage, but replication delay is increased by 1s.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Mark Hex:[/b] Marks deal +100% total damage but your Weapons can only trigger them with Criticals.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Melee Hex:[/b] Melee weapons total damage +50% but ranged weapons total damage -50%.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Ranged Hex:[/b] Ranged weapons total damage +50% but melee weapons total damage -50%.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Overwhelm Hex:[/b] Hits have a 25% chance to Overwhelm, but all other total damage -50%.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Rush Hex:[/b] Rush total damage +100% but it no longer stuns.[/spoiler]
 - [b](NEW)[/b] [spoiler][b]Simple Hex:[/b] Weapon total damage +100% but you can no longer use Alterattacks.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]Weapons Update[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Anchor Boom[/b]: Burn damage now scales with the Weapon's level. Combo and Charged attacks damages reduced
[*][b]Katars[/b]: Alterattack's Bleed Infusion damage now scales with the Weapon's level.
[*][b]Fishing Rod[/b]: Alterattack's Bleed damage now scales with the Weapon's level.
[*][b]Sirocco[/b]: Burn damage now scales with the Weapon's level.
[*][b]Eye Blade:[/b] Mark damage now scales with the Weapon's level. 
[*][b]Kunais[/b]: Curse percentage now scales with the Weapon's level.
[*][b]Sharp Sisters[/b]: AlterAttack initial dash do less damage but persisting tornadoes do more
[/list]

[h2]Shield Weapon Update[/h2]
[list]
[*]⭐️ [b]Alterattack[/b]:
 - the Alterattack is now a fully defensive move: both the inital action and the ethereal shields do not deal damage anymore
 - the spawned ethereal shields can only be destroyed by incoming attack, they now protect you from a hit during 7 sec
 - they also now protect you from any side and flight closer to you
 - unchanged: the initial action still briefly stuns enemies, you can still spawn several shields
[*]⭐️ [b]Guard[/b]:
 - damage reduction increased by 50%
 - damage reflection increased by 50%
[*]⭐️ [b]Parry[/b]:
 - damage increased by 25%
 - launch window is [i]sightly[/i] shorter by 20%
[*] Having the Shield in-hand (by being the last weapon used) does not reduces damage anymore
[/list]


[h2]Trinkets Update[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Bush:[/b] the bonus damage now comes from a Brutality activation of 1s
[*][b]Mark Zone:[/b] Base damage increased to 100 (from 80). Now also triggers all nearby Marks when used, so it can better combo with other Mark gifts.
[*][b]Goo Bomb[/b]: Now deals Corrosive damage.
[*][b]Burn Aura[/b]: Burn base damage changed to 2 (from 2.5).
[/list]

[h2]Affixes Update[/h2]
[list]
[*]Most affixes now scale with the Gear's level or are using Total damage.
[*][b]Damage over time area:[/b] Now a Corrosive Pool, and more trinkets can have this affix. Changed damage to 10 per hit (from 5).
[*][b]Alterattack bonus:[/b] Now multiplies the Alterattack bonus damage by 1.25.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]⭐️ [b]Inventory[/b]: items and buttons are no longer overlapping when player has many items
[*]⭐️ [b]LD[/b]: Tubes in Incubator will now need to be destroyed to unlock chests or gates
[*]⭐️ [b]HeadBanger[/b]: fixed an edge-case where the pillar spawned by the boss would not activate itself and stay visually even after the boss's death
[*]⭐️ [b]Naveless Brothers[/b]: fixed an issue with the Bush trinket were the bosses would re-do their initial shockwave attack when exiting the stealth mode
[*]⭐️ [b]Sycthes[/b]: fixed issue when a scythe was destroyed on hit but was meant to hit multiple other targets
[*][b]Visuals[/b]: Golem Hammer was missing one of its weapons
[*]Various under the hood fixes
[*]⭐️ [b]Co-op[/b]: it's now possible for a player to be considered AFK even if he is in a cinematic
[*]⭐️ [b]Co-op / UI[/b]: when viewing other players' boons, descriptions will now be shown based on their stats instead of yours

[*][b]Co-op / UI[/b]: fixed missing notification telling that we are waiting for other players' interactions
[*]⭐️ [b]Visuals[/b]: fixed having the Shop's windsock clipping through the camera when you are at a biome's end Banking Fish
[*]⭐️ [b]Collisions:[/b] fixed some invisible collisions
[*]⭐️ [b]Softlock[/b]: fixed passing through some gate when performing attacks, blocking you from going back
[*]⭐️ [b]Weapons: Shield[/b]: fixed being able to parry explosions on the floor which led to super weird movements [i](you can still parry large melee hits like the one from the Golem's jump attack)[/i]
[*][b]Enemies[/b]: fixed having some rare ghost hits touching the players
[*]⭐️ [b]Enemies[/b]: fixed enemies being sometime stuck on destructible props like jars
[*]⭐️ [b]Weapons: Shield[/b]: fixed triggering some perfect dodge that makes no sense [i](rare)[/i]
[*]⭐️ [b]Rewards[/b]: fixed some enemies' projectiles blocking chests from opening even after fight end
[/list]

tags.feature: We're adding some awesome new Gifts to the game! [b]17 in fact![/b] With some being brand new effects altogether! [b]Corrosion[/b] and [b]Overwhelm[/b] are making their way into the Vortex and offer some super fun new ways to bring down unsuspecting Golems!
We're also adding a bunch of new options to things like [b]Blast, Bleed, Echo, and more[/b]. Meaning you have even more freedom when to comes to builds.

Hexes have received a boost too, with [b]16 new ones arriving in this update![/b] You'll find reworked and upgraded options to existing Hexes, with new additions that will make some builds even more insane (spoiler alert: DoT builds just got serious... 👀).

We've also moved Hexes onto their own Inventory slot, meaning they no longer share capacity with their non-hexed counterparts. This should allow you to not only push your builds further, but not have to sacrifice a key Gift for your build because you have a Hex in play too.
With most Windblown patches, we introduce new weapons too! And this time is no different! We're adding [b]TWO[/b] brand new weapons to the game, one of which might look familiar!

[b]Impactone [/b]- A slow swinging, long reaching weapon which may look familiar to players who have ventured into the Sanctuary Biome. It's Alterattack launches two sweeping lasers which collide in the middle, devastating anything caught in their path.

[b]Jar [/b]- The Jar uses the Shells you collect as ammunition, increasing in damage for every shot you fire in a chain. If you run out of Shells, you'll fire small rocks instead. Not as impactful, but they still hurt! The Alterattack fires a huge Shell which explodes on impact, firing out smaller projectiles that bounce and launch even more.

[b]Bonus Update[/b] - The Shield has received an update! It now absorbs way more incoming damage and its parry attack deals more. The Alterattack’s ethereal shields now protect you from a hit, making it a fully defensive move. Check out the full update in the patch notes at the end of this post! 👇
Finally, we've added important items to players Inventories. This allows you to see what items or upgrades you may have picked up during your time in Windblown e.g. Banger Pulsor.

[b]16 new Hexes[/b]

Base x (Sum of Standard damage bonuses) x (Sum of Total damage bonuses).[/i]

tags.balance_change: ⭐️ [b]Gifts have been updated[/b], rebalanced, removed, clarified or merged following player feedbacks. This update focuses on improving the current base, and we will add more Gift-related content in future updates.

⭐️ Many [b]effects[/b] that had fixed values [b]now scale with your progression in the expedition[/b], and at higher difficulties. Gifts with the "Auto scaling" icon now scale with the amount of Bosses killed.
⭐️ [b]Crystallize[/b]: accelerated chained Crystallize with ranged weapons
[b]Gear[/b]: Rebalanced how weapons and trinkets scale with their level.

[b]Survivor[/b]: Can now be replaced and is now consumed when used. Now heals for 100% (from 50%).
[b]Boss Killer[/b]: Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. Value changed to 35% to compensate (from 40%).
[b]Duelist[/b]: Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. Value reduced to 25% to compensate (from 60%). Applies to both Weapons and Trinkets.
[b]Tranquility[/b]: Now only applied to Ranged Weapons. Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. Value changed to 25% to compensate (from 60%).
[b]Proximity[/b]: Now only applied to Melee Weapons. Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. Value changed to 35% to compensate (from 40%).
[b]Midas[/b]: Bonus damage changed to 4% per 100 gold (from 5%).
[b]Advanced Alterattacks[/b]: No longer reduces Alterattack damage.
[b]Super Alterattacks[/b]: Now multiplies the Alterattack bonus by 1.5.

[b]Bleeding Criticals[/b]: Bleed damage changed to 1.5 autoscaling (from 1.5 flat)
[b]Hemorrhage[/b]: Upgraded to a Total damage bonus. Bonus damage improved to +100% (from +50%).
[b]Bleed Infusion[/b]: Now also applies to Trinket hits.
Now feedbacks its current bonus damage value near its icon.
[b]Brutal Trinkets[/b]: Bonus damage changed to 50% autoscaling (from 60% flat).
[b]Brutal Alternation[/b]: Bonus damage changed to 30% autoscaling (from 40% flat).
[b]Deadly Brutality[/b]: Bonus damage changed to 60% autoscaling (from 60% flat).
[b]Powerful Brutality[/b]: Bonus damage changed to 8% every second, autoscaling (from 10% flat).
Burn counters above enemies now feedback when the maximum amount is reached.

[b]Burning Criticals[/b]: Burn damage changed to 3 autoscaling (from 4.5 flat)

notes.content: [h1]Hey all![/h1][p][/p][p]Our latest Open Beta build just went live, delivering an update which [b]completely overhauls the Gift system![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Gifts are a major part of Windblown[/b], and are paramount to how your builds come together. However, some of them have felt lacking, and some weren't scaling properly with new features, like Endless Mode. So, we've taken the time to dive back into the ocean of Gifts in the game, and give them all an update![/p][p][/p][h3]Let's take a top line look at what's coming with this Gift focused update![/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Gifts[/b] - You'll find 17 new Gifts in the game, adding more flexibility and options to builds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gift Rework[/b] - A HUGE amount of gifts have been reworked, including some gifts/effects being deleted and replaced altogether.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Inventory Items[/b] - All the important objects collected during your adventure are now visible in your Inventory.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weapons[/b] - \[spoiler]Impactone and Jar.\[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hexes[/b] - Now have dedicated slots.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]You'll also find a [b]bunch of QoL and balance changes coming in this new patch[/b], all aimed at improving player experience with the game. [/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy taking these new Gifts for a spin, and seeing how the reworked existing ones feel after this update![/p][p][/p][h3]How to access the beta[/h3][list][*][p] Go to your Steam game library. notes.title: Windblown | "From the Leapers" Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Leapers![/h1]

[h2]Our "From the Leapers" update is out now![/h2]

[previewyoutube=EavGGl6vIi0;full][/previewyoutube]

Although this update is smaller than the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1911610/view/546727671271263754]Endless Mode[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1911610/view/533220673935377413]Sanctuary[/url] patches, it was born from the passion of our players! Your feedback on Windblown has been paramount to it's development so far, so we thought a patch dedicated to that feedback would be cool!

[b]Let's take a look at what's coming in our 4th update![/b]

[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[h3]Memory Deck[/h3]

This HIGHLY requested feature has finally landed! A lot of players have asked for the ability to remove certain memories from their runs, to better tailor their experience when heading into the Vortex. This means you can now choose what weapons show up, along with trinkets and gifts. Want to go for a Burning & Bleed BeatBolt Build, this'll help!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/b2e8918871c2f2937397d10fe05f47b88b75a9dc.png[/img]

[h3]Timed Chests[/h3]

These new chests can be found at the end of each Biome, but will only open if you make it to them in time. This is an extra reward for those of you used to the Vortex and its challenges, but will also help to incentivise newer Leapers to push ahead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/c742ab771beb0c2d057363ce75cbcc9cdd59dc1c.png[/img]

[h3]New Skins[/h3]

You'll now find that Rabbit, Tiger, and Jay skins have been added to the game! Some of the most requested additions since we began Early Access. You'll need to push through Endless Mode on varying difficulties to unlock each one though.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/0ced1c4ed08eb206eabbad2a64a663d9d1c2f049.gif[/img]

[h3]Improved Performance through Upscaling[/h3]

A big talking point from the Community has been Windblown's performance, especially on lower end GPUs and Steam Deck. We want the game to be enjoyable and playable for as many people as possible, so we've dedicated some time to enhancing the performance across the board. You'll now find Upscaling will be enabled as default on Steam Deck and lower performance GPUs, but can be toggled in the settings either way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/bb70486598980e1391ccc320ee0c20d05d98c60d.png[/img]

[h1]Extras[/h1]

There are of course a bunch of other additions coming to the game!

[b]Incentivised Biomes[/b] - We know that everyone has their favourite route to take when you set off from the Ark. But this means some biomes aren't as popular as others - to help keep things fresh and to encourage players to try the path less travelled, you'll now find that when picking a biome (Rat Village & Sanctuary for example) there'll be extra rewards in one of them. C'mon, mix it up a little!

[b]Mouse Aiming Enhancements[/b] - We've made improvements to our mouse aiming algorithm to help with accuracy and handling of attacks. You may know we've done several updates on this, and will continue to refine and work with the community to get it just right!

[b]QoL and Bugfixes[/b] - Visual and VFX changes, along with the requested feature for the game to pause in single-player if your controller disconnects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/1dfb53d96518d680108412665284705c6dcf8bec.png[/img]


[h3]Plus much more! Check out the patch notes below for the full breakdown[/h3]


We want to thank you all again for your help on Windblown! This update is a thankyou to all of the players that have helped shaped Windblown into what it is today. There is still A LOT of work to do, and we hope you're along for the journey with us!

Until next time!

-MT

[h1]BONUS NEWS[/h1]

You may have heard of a little game called [b]Clair Obscur: Expedition 33[/b], but did you know you can grab both that and Windblown in a bundle right now?! 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53651/Clair_Obscur_Expedition_33__Windblown/

We'll be adding the final version of our latest Sanctuary track to the games OST, which lines up perfectly for a little Discount!

Windblown and it's soundtrack are currently[b] 20% off from now until the 22nd May![/b] 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46045/Windblown__OST/

But that's not all... 👀

We know that the Windblown soundtrack has become beloved amongst our fans, and the living legend that is [url=https://2emedanger.com/]DANGER[/url] has created something truly amazing!

[h3]Introducing the [i][b]Windblown Original Soundtrack - Limited Edition Cassette[/b][/i][/h3]

[url=https://1789records.bigcartel.com/product/danger-windblown-ost-limited-edition-cassette][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/268ff0cd2bf9b7b0ef743596b7d3fcaa20d0f7fe.jpg[/img][/url]


[h3]You can pre-order this incredibly awesome, incredibly limited edition cassette [url=https://1789records.bigcartel.com/product/danger-windblown-ost-limited-edition-cassette]here[/url]! (Shipping will begin in July 2025)[/h3]

notes.content:
[h1]Hey Leapers![/h1]

[*] Click close and wait for the upload to finish downloading.

notes.title: Windblown | Sanctuary Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Leapers![/h1]

[h1]✨Sanctuary is OUT NOW✨[/h1]

Check out our brand new Community Trailer for (almost) all of the info!

[previewyoutube=LzaUwC6bkz0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[h3]Sanctuary[/h3]
Sanctuary is a new spooky Biome, filled with plenty of mysteries and enemies to face. To access it though requires a bit of ground work - [b]Start a new run and find Carlos at the end of the Factory Biome. He'll have a task for you.[/b] Once complete you'll have a new option when you defeat Headbanger, to either jump into Rat Village or take on Sanctuary.

Carlos isn't just a means to getting into Sanctuary though, he has some interesting [b]information about the Ark and it's inhabitants.[/b] This is the [b]first of many quests that will be added to the game[/b] which will help dive into the [b]lore and story[/b] of Windblown - so stay tuned for more to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/a14561545cf60fa939e7b7f320a498b047c802e5.png[/img]


[h3]New Enemies[/h3]
Any new biome wouldn't be complete without some new challenges. So we've added a bunch of new enemies for you to face, with some stronger versions littered about too. You'll have to tackle lasers, bombs, electricity, sweeping attacks, oh, and a healing unit... To break it down, you'll find: 5 new Sentinel enemies: the [b]Drone, Head, Paladin, Priest and Caster.[/b] Along with 3 variant Sentinel enemies: the [b]Alpha Drone, Feral Drone and Alpha Paladin.[/b]

[h3]Plus... A BRAND NEW BOSS![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/57ec0abda5f98a3f273960901a04ae38650f023b.png[/img]

[h3]Weapons & Trinket[/h3]

We've added 4 new weapons! That's right, 4!!
[list]
[*] [b]Sharp Sisters[/b] - A pair of dual blades that brave Leapers may find familiar. Their Alterattack leaves a deadly flurry of blades behind as you dash forward!
[*] [b]Elder Blade[/b] - Split the earth, like... 7 times. Knocking enemies back, and even off the map!
[*] [b]Sentinel Wings[/b] - Sentinel Wings go bbbbbbrrrrrr. Or more accurately they fire huge lasers, perfect for eradicating anything that might stand in your way.
[*] [b]Fishing Rod[/b] - To go fishing with... Nah, it's great for wide sweeping attacks and yeeting enemies into the abyss!
[/list]
Plus a brand new Trinket called the [b]Chrono Catcher![/b] - This thing drops a zone on the ground which slows enemies inside. It'll also put the brakes on any projectiles that might end up flying through!

[h3]Sharp Sisters[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/fb033ebdc081169bdfe84f87f5db3dc2ec9fc382.gif[/img]

[h3]Elder Sword[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/7641b1c1750f9897ac9d78f2bfa249ea2ad62ef5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/df6f2e195ccd912a5f986ad2bfa6217910666be4.gif[/img]

[h3]Chrono Catch[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/ed19cdbadb4d031f3125b739f70ef50e46c2c5ba.gif[/img]

[h2]Extras[/h2]
We're also adding:
[list]
[*][b]2 new enemy variants[/b] (Fungal Swamp and Rat Village)
[*][b]1 new skin[/b] - Obsidian Axolotl
[*][b]New Accessibility Options[/b] - See allies VFX and tweak stick dead zones on gamepads
[*][b]Hide UI[/b] - You can now press F3 to hide your HUD (another community request!)
[*][b]5 new upgrades at Eperin[/b] - all of which were inspired by the community!
[list]
[*]2 that increase the amount of items in the main shops
[*]1 that adds small new specific Boosts to the shops and gates pool
[*]2 that add new training racks to test Gifts and Trinkets/Magifishes in the Ark
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Plus...[/h2]

[h3]Magifish Recharge Rework[/h3]
We've changed how these helpful fish recharge! You no longer have to wait for a timer, but instead can recharge them by dealing damage to enemies. This is an important improvement that will encourage you to commit more during fights.

[h3]NEW: Retrieve Your Remains[/h3]
We know it can be tough when you die on a run and lose what you're carrying. So we've added a new system that allows you to retrieve your Cogs, Memonites and Encrypted Memories by starting a new run and reaching where you died. You'll see an indicator appear at the edge of your screen when you get close to your remains. If you don't make it back to that point however, they're gone for good (or until they drop again)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/bc7e9d8ecc07964d70283999265434a9504c9918.gif[/img]

[h3]Revenge Mode Update[/h3]
We're making some changes to Revenge Mode as well, to bring it more in line with what we envisioned. When an ally is downed, you'll still go into the familiar fit of rage, but now you'll have an energy gauge that will slowly deplete over time - if it hits zero, you're dead. Dealing damage and killing enemies will increase the gauge, and if you fill it to the top, you'll revive your allies!


[h3]NEW: Encrypted Memories Bad Luck Protection[/h3]
We've added a type of 'bad luck protection' to the game to help make farming for Memories easier. This means that if you're looking for something specific like a weapon or skin, you won't potentially be grinding forever (we will start counting from this version, we don't have records of previous drops).


[h2]You can catch the full patch notes below 👇[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/aab07a1251e84e49cb4834641ce44ed00bf5b61f.gif[/img]

But for now, we want to thank you for checking Sanctuary out! It's been an absolute blast getting to bring a brand new biome to Windblown. We hope you have a great time diving in and uncovering its mysteries!

Catch you all real soon!

-MT

notes.title: Windblown | Endless Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

We know you've been waiting a little longer than usual for this one, but we couldn't stop working on cool additions!

[b]But the day has come, and Endless Mode is now available on Live servers![/b]

And as per usual, we've thrown together a neat little trailer to talk you through most of the new additions to the game! (Sadly we couldn't include them all, otherwise our poor Community Manager would still be recording voice over).

Check it out!

[previewyoutube=HJlHfWRWGZM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Key Features[/h1]

[h3]Endless Mode[/h3]

This new game mode turns Windblown up to 11 (as if it wasn't already there...). Once you complete a run, you'll be given the option of returning to the Ark, or starting a new run while keeping your existing boosts and gifts. You'll then be able to keep adding new boosts and unlock new gift slots, meaning you can push your builds to insane levels!

[h3]Thrift Shop[/h3]

Another key part of the Endless Mode Update is the introduction of gear reforging, which can be unlocked in the Ark when speaking to Eperin. This adds the ability to both upgrade and rework your weapons and trinkets once you arrive at the shop in each biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/26a6f3247eac2440498e57777ecd83f599e0855e.png[/img]

[h1]Revamped Content[/h1]

[h3]Goo Brush and Shield Rework[/h3]

We've spent some time reworking both the Goo Brush and Shield weapons in Windblown. These weren't exactly fan favourites (game dev skill issue...), so we've worked on both their key mechanics and Alterattacks. The Goo Brush now has better hit registration, along with a projectile styled Alterattack, whereas the Shield no longer makes you immune to damage, but offers a tasty buff with it's reworked Alterattack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/7b3ea576a9e865c8d14a2d126d0b528c0fff18af.gif[/img]

[h3]Fungal Swamp Boss[/h3]

It's been no secret that the Fungal Swamp boss needed a new lick of paint, so we went back and overhauled the encounter to make it more suitable for our Mushroom filled starting Biome. For example, we've added a bunch of new attacks and mushroom like obstacles to watch out for, along with its usual overhead slam which some of you keep dying to.

[h1]Quality of Life Features[/h1]

[h3]Co-op Difficulty Selector[/h3]

Based on player feedback we heard that it wasn't always clear which difficulty you were joining when looking for multiplayer games. To help with this we've added a new icon on the server browser which will show the difficulty of the game you're about to join.[b] It's worth adding that you will not be able to join a game with a difficulty higher than what you have unlocked.[/b]

[h3]Sigourney's Codex[/h3]

We wanted a way to let you track some of the things you've been up to in Windblown. So if you head to Sigourney on her tower in the Ark, she'll now show you things like number of expeditions completed,  what your highest completed Loop is in Endless Mode, or even the number of enemies you've killed (you bunch of monsters...). This is just the beginning of what we'd like to track and show, so keep your eyes peeled for more stats in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/cd653e789a737af78214ce61f7da8958c8367c77.png[/img]

[h3]Persistent Save[/h3]

Something we added at the beginning of Early Access was allowing players to maintain their progress during a run. Meaning if you left the game mid way through a run, you could jump back in later on and be in the same spot. This wasn't the case if an update dropped for the game though, which actually forced you back to the Ark, effectively ending your run. We've now updated this system to allow you to keep your progress, well... to an extent at least. We aren't able to have the game remember your exact position and progress within a Biome. But if you leave the game now and an update arrives before you next play, you'll be placed back at the beginning of the Biome you were on, not in the Ark. Meaning that Loop 13 Endless run you're working on won't be totally ruined! 

[h3]Duplicate Saves[/h3]

[h3]Duplicate Saves[/h3]

A big ask from the community is to be able to duplicate saves. Well, now you can! This means you're able to try out new things without changing your main save file! Perfect for those players wanting to keep the same unlocks, or challenge themselves with only certain gear. Plus, you'll be able to make a copy of your progress next time a Beta rolls around, maintaining your main save while testing out the new content on a separate version.

[h1]What's Next?[/h1] 

This update pushes everything to the limit, so we had to make sure the code could handle the insanity Endless Mode brings! Not to mention us continuingly adding new things for everyone to enjoy! We hope you have an absolute BLAST with Endless Mode, and we can't wait to see how far you manage to push!

[b]But for now, we're jumping back into work on the brand new Biome, which we think you're all going to love![/b]

Catch you later!

-MT

[list]
[*]⭐️ Endless mode: continue your runs indefinitely with an updated set of rules!
[*][spoiler]Sigourney[/spoiler]'s Codex: new menu accessible from once you've rescued her. Currently, it only shows very few and simple stats - more will come later on!

notes.title: What's next? Endless Mode, New Biome, and... ROADMAP!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

We're back from a well needed break, and are raring to go! Much like the end of last year, we left you all with a brand new content update for the game. And today we're not just saying hello, we've got some exciting news on the next additions to Windblown!

[h1]Soon: Endless Mode[/h1]

This new game mode will enable you to continue your run when you beat Incubator, meaning you can start from your chosen first biome again while keeping your current build and weapons. [b]Now, this can stack infinitely, and your progress will be displayed just to the right of your health bar (above the difficulty), like this![/b] 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/438b4ae9dd7f4e01063ddd992b04053c73c9560c.gif[/img]

This means you'll be able to keep increasing your stats, adapt your build and hit new heights! Enemies will continue to get stronger as well though, so make sure you can keep up with the ever increasing challenge.

Here's an example of the insanity you can achieve! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/adf3bd34a08b389cddbc99fe8420c127f4b2c58a.gif[/img]

Endless Mode has begun internal testing now, and will hopefully be hitting the live servers in the coming weeks!

[h1]Late Q1: NEW BIOME![/h1]

Now, we don't have anything specific to share just yet, but we wanted to let you all know that there's a brand new Biome in the oven! So keep your eyes peeled for more information on this soon.

We're curious to hear what you all think it might be 👀

[h1]Next: Roadmap[/h1]

And on top of all of this super exciting news, we've also thrown a Roadmap together!

You can check out what we have planned for the game below! 

We do have some needed context however - we wanted to keep things very top line. The development of Windblown is incredibly dynamic, and is heavily influenced by the community. This means that we may add things into the plan, or even delay or remove some plans in favour of something more pressing. We’ll keep you all up to date as things progress!

notes.title: Windblown | The Revenge Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hey all![/h1]

[h2]The Revenge Update for Windblown is OUT NOW on Steam Early Access![/h2]

This update brings with it a bunch of new content, along with a totally revamped version of Sudden Death - [b]The Revenge Mode![/b]

This patch and its content is all thanks to you, the players! Your feedback and input has been invaluable to the games development and direction. We hope you enjoy diving into the new build, and bringing vengeance on behalf of your fallen allies!

[previewyoutube=RcBFPD2CmwA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New Weapons[/h1]

[h3]Fiery Claws[/h3]

These lightning fast claws are perfect for getting up close and personal with the Sentinels. They dish out damage quickly, and can launch projectiles with a held attack. It's Alterattack turns this up to 11 though, launching you into the air and firing a bunch of flaming heads upon impact! Kinda like a certain boss?

[h3]Umbrella[/h3]

Hibiki’s Umbrella is a unique addition to your arsenal, allowing you to equip a wind-wielding weapon aimed at tearing enemies to shreds with mini-tornadoes! The end of its attack string launches one tornado, whereas its Alterattack launches three! Oh, and did we mention that they track enemies and deal damage over time? Perfect for a DoT build, or if you want to use the Vortex's tricks against it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/eccf42c67eeac79bcc24f9ac31adbf1864d4730c.gif[/img]

[h1]New Trinkets[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Bleed Aura[/b] - Generate an area that infuses the attacks of yourself and allies to apply bleed to enemies. Perfect for building up high stacks fast and watching enemies fall to pieces.
[*] [b]Mark Zone[/b] - Marks all enemies within a zone, setting them up for a devastating detonation. Use this with some Mark specific Gifts, and you're going to cause some serious damage!
[*] [b]Ultra Laser[/b] - BOOM! ...That's about it... Or more specifically launches a huge murder laser at the closest target. Decimating it and anything else that may be too close.
[*] [b]L-BRO (Shooting Bot)[/b] - Your newest adorable companion. Designed to follow you around and harry your foes from afar. Activate its ability though, and you'll turn up the heat, increasing L-BRO's attack speed.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/5ece0a06eb7d2c4e2f8c526d5cf713b2cdafe79a.gif[/img]

[h1]Revenge Mode[/h1]

A full revamp of the Sudden Death mechanic! In this new version you are no longer one shot, and instead become enraged at the sigh of you allies falling. You deal increased damage and move quicker, but your enemies also hit harder too. Oh, and using flasks is disabled as well, so watch out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781312/d20d41170f65eb04e0396ff899b8a26b3261c7f2.gif[/img]

[h1]New Skins[/h1]

We've added 4 new skins which are unlocked by completing runs on increasing difficulty. Which means if you've already cleared the game on Cataclysmic, you'll need to go back to lower difficulties to grab any skins you may have missed!

[list]
[*] Toad 
[*] Chimera Axolotl 
[*] Badger Bat
[*] Horned Lizard
[/list]

[h1]Bestiary Enhancements[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Rat Village Boss[/b] - Based on your feedback, we've reworked the boss at the end of the Rat Village. He is now much more punishing, has a bunch of new moves, and can be a real challenge if you're not expecting it! We also made some upgrades to the Headbanger version too, making it much more difficult to deal with.

[h1]New Languages[/h1]

[h1]WHAT'S TO COME[/h1]

Well, A LOT, that's what!

We have big plans for Windblown, and the work has only just begun! We'll be taking a small break over the next couple of weeks as we recharge from what has been total chaos! But rest assured, we'll be back in early 2025 with a continued sense of determination for Windblown!

[b]From everyone on the Motion Twin crew - we hope you have a restful and peaceful holiday period! We'll see you on the other side![/b]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[i]⭐️ = community inspired[/i]

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]⭐️ Co-op: new Revenge Mode
[*]2 new weapons: Fiery Claws & Umbrella
[*]4 new trinkets: Ultra Laser, Mark Zone, Bleed Aura + our first pet L-BR0!
[*]⭐️ 4 new skins: rewards when finishing the game at higher difficulties
[*]9 new enemy variants!
[*]⭐️ Weapons can now have a dynamic Alterattack ignition bonus: Shield (from +40 to +200%), Boomerang (from 0 to +100%)
[*][spoiler]Rat Village[/spoiler]'s Miniboss ([spoiler]Pirate Captain[/spoiler]) revamp including new animations and attack patterns
[*][spoiler]Rat Village's optional[/spoiler] Miniboss ([spoiler]The Headbanger's Head[/spoiler]) revamp including new attack patterns
[*]Gift slots can now appear as Path choice rewards (if you unlocked the ability to obtain them)
[*]⭐️ Boosts: small boosts were removed and replaced by big boosts. Boosts will always have one special proposition that gives a reduced stat but an added maximum health bonus. This is an experimental change to make choices more interesting and streamline health gain - we welcome any feedback!
[*]Added new chunks in [spoiler]Factory[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Incubator[/spoiler] biomes
[*]⭐️ New mouse aiming algorithm: will especially enhance your accuracy when using distant weapons

[*]Enemies: [spoiler]Naveless Triplet Rogue[/spoiler] is more intelligible but more dangerous (especially the [spoiler]Big one[/spoiler])

notes.title: 1st Early Access Update Open Beta
notes.content:
[h1]Hey all![/h1]

We have some super exciting news today!

We have just opened up a public beta branch for the first update for Windblown! With this, you'll be able to jump in and test the new patch ahead of its release later this month. 

Remember, the whole point of these beta tests are for the team to gather data and feedback from players, so you should expect some bugs and quirks during your time on this build! 

Now, there are a few very important things to let you know about first!

[h1]⚠️If you choose to play this version of the game, your save will change to the beta branch, and will no longer work on the public build until the update’s full release. UNLESS you make a new save and use that instead⚠️[/h1]

Also, until full release, please note that multiplayer games are version-tied, so you’ll solely be able to play with other beta testers.

Here's the basics:

[list]
[*] Playing the beta branch will mean you can't use your existing save on the public branch. You will be able to play it on the public branch again once the patch launches.
[*] You can make a new save when you load up the beta branch, but it will be a brand new game. Again, you will be able to play it on the public branch again once the patch launches.
[*] You can play with other players so long as you're on the same build. So public branch players can't play with beta branch players, and vice versa.
[/list]

[h2]How to access the beta[/h2]

[list]
[*] Go to your Steam game library.
[*] Right click on Windblown and click "properties".
[*] Select the tab "Betas".
[*] In the first dropdown box select "public_beta"
[*] Click close and wait for the upload to finish downloading.
[/list]

[h2]What's in the patch?[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]⭐ Revenge Mode[/b] - A full revamp of the Sudden Death mechanic! In this new version you are no longer one shot, and instead become enraged at the sigh of you allies falling. You deal increased damage and move quicker, but your enemies also hit harder too. Oh, and using flasks is disabled as well, so watch out!
[*][b]2 New Weapons[/b] - Hibiki’s Umbrella and Fiery Claws make their debut in Windblown, both with their own move sets and Alterattacks.
[*][b]4 New Trinkets[/b] - You'll find 4 new trinkets in the game - Bleed Aura, Mark Zone, L-BRO (a shooting pet!), Ultra Laser. Each of which should help you further specialise your builds and playstyles!
[*][b]4 New Skins[/b] - You'll be able to find the Toad, Horned Lizard, Badger Bat and Chimera Axolotl skins while playing the game! Just keep pushing as far as you can, and you'll find them.

notes.title: Windblown | Post-launch Recap & December Patch!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

It's been a crazy month since launch, and the team is so thankful for all of your passion and support since we released Windblown into Steam Early Access. Your feedback has been paramount to what we've been working on next!

Speaking of which, [b]we'll be releasing Windblown's first feature patch this month[/b], which we're calling the [b]Revenge Update![/b]

It'll include [b]new weapons, skins, trinkets, and huge updates of some major enemies and level design reworks, along with the long awaited Sudden Death rework - replaced by The Revenge Mode![/b] Stay tuned for updates on this patch soon.

It became clear early on that keyboard and mouse users wanted more control over their character and it's targeting. So we added a new way to aim using the mouse, but also allowed players who preferred the existing method to continue using it.
[*][b]Bug fixes & QoL[/b] - plus a buuuunch of smaller fixes and tweaks to the game to improve everyone's experience. For example, weapon fixes, gift changes, and enemy tweaks.
[*][b]Balancing[/b] - tweaking things that were just too strong, and buffing things that needed a bit of love. Balance is super important and something we will continuously monitor.

notes.title: Discord AMA Recap
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

[b]And welcome to the very first Windblown AMA![/b]

For context, we hosted a livestream over in the Windblown Discord on November 5th. We took this opportunity to answer as many questions as we could from the Community, and shed some light on future plans for the game and overall project!

(Oh, quick update on one of the major topics...) [h3]Sudden Death![/h3]

We're working on this as we speak and hope to deploy a reworked version [b]next month.[/b]

[b]If you'd like to watch the VoD of the livestream, you can check it out just below, or for a recap of the questions asked and answered, you can find all the info below![/b]

[previewyoutube=_JW2YiwnTSU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]AMA Recap[/h1]

[h3]Dash Mechanic Design[/h3]

The dash mechanic was one of the first features worked on when the team began developing Windblown. Initially, the game wasn’t designed to be fast-paced, but frustration with the existing systems led them to introduce the dash, which became a key element in shaping the game's faster pace.

[h3]Main Inspirations for Windblown[/h3]

The game draws from various influences, though many of them are not directly related. The initial inspiration was to create a game like Ragnarok Online, but Windblown evolved into something quite different. Combat was inspired by Platinum Games (e.g. Bayonetta), while build systems drew from Binding of Isaac and Monster Hunter. Visually, it takes cues from games like Fury, Hyper Light Drifter, and Zelda, particularly the floating islands. The team also wanted to explore unusual animal designs, inspired by games like Fury and Dead Cells.

[h3]Vision for Town Building (The Ark)[/h3]

The idea of building the ark was initially planned but had to be rethought due to time constraints. Instead, the game will focus on rescuing NPCs who will join the ark and unlock new features. While the town-building aspect is not a priority, the team is interested in creating a meaningful "prep" phase before missions, inspired by Monster Hunter, where players can prepare for the next run (e.g., cooking or other activities).

[h3]Roadmap for Upcoming Content[/h3]

The team is focused on gathering feedback and addressing core issues early in the game's Early Access phase. While there is a roadmap which can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1911610/view/4548164157823279220?l=english]here[/url], the team are working on urgent fixes and building the game's foundation. Content like new biomes, weapons, monsters, and customisation will be added, but we can't confirm any specific timings just yet. The team is also discussing how future content, such as biomes, will be tied to the game’s narrative. Once we have a clearer picture of upcoming features, we'll be sure to let everyone know!

[h3]Modding Support[/h3]

Modding support is a complicated issue and, at the moment, it's not a priority. The main challenge is that Windblown is a multiplayer game with a deterministic system, meaning it’s not inherently designed to support mods. Additionally, even games like Dead Cells, which have modding potential, are somewhat limited in this regard because they weren’t built with modding in mind. The team are focused on completing the core game first, and only after that could they look into the potential of modding.

[h3]Overarching Narrative and Lore[/h3]

We plan to introduce a narrative, but it will not focus on the specific playable characters. Instead, the story will centre on the inhabitants of the Ark and explore their motivations for venturing into the Vortex. The characters are essentially orphans living on the Ark, and the narrative will gradually reveal why they are undertaking these dangerous runs. The lore will help explain the world and the players' goals, but it won’t delve into detailed backstories for individual characters. The narrative will be broader, focusing on the Ark as a community and the shared quest for answers.

[h3]Sudden Death Mechanic[/h3]

The Sudden Death mechanic was designed to create a strong sense of tension and teamwork among players. It was the result of multiple iterations and testing of different multiplayer death mechanics. The core idea is to make players feel that they are directly tied to each other’s survival—if one player goes down, the others need to act quickly to save them. This was intended to encourage cooperation and emotional investment in the team’s success. However, the feedback from players has pointed out that it can lead to frustration, especially in multiplayer sessions where communication is difficult, such as without voice chat. While the intention behind the mechanic is to make the game more dynamic and intense, we recognise that it currently causes more frustration than enjoyment.

The team is working on improving the feature, and they are considering adjusting it to make it less punishing while maintaining the intent to foster teamwork. One issue they identified is that the health bar is disconnected from the Sudden Death mechanic, which confuses players and leads to situations where they can maximize damage output but are at a disadvantage when it comes to healing or recovery. We have started prototyping new versions that aim to make the mechanic more "merciful" and enjoyable, but balancing it for all players has been difficult. Some players love the current system, while others hate it, so the team are focused on finding a middle ground. The feature might also be renamed to better reflect its evolving design.

[h3]Stat Sheet After Runs[/h3]

The game already has a system in place to track player stats, such as damage dealt and types of damage. This feature was initially used for development purposes but is currently deactivated. While the team has high-priority tasks to work on, such as fixing the Sudden Death mechanic, they do plan to re-enable the stat tracking in future updates. The intention is to provide players with a recap of their performance after each run, offering insights into how they contributed to the team’s success. However, the team doesn’t have a set timeline for when this will be implemented, as they are focused on other urgent features first. That said, the stat recap is definitely something we want to add once more pressing issues are addressed.

[h3]Accessibility Features[/h3]

We are working on adding several features to make the game more accessible for a wider audience. One of the key features is the ability to adjust the dash mechanic so that you can hold the button to auto dash earlier on in the game. which has been a point of frustration for some players. As the game progresses, the team plans to include an option that allows players to adjust this mechanic to suit their playstyle and comfort level. Additionally, there is an "auto-combo" feature that was tested but was deactivated during the alpha for further refinement. The auto-combo feature would allow players to perform combos automatically, which could help those who find the combat mechanics difficult or tiring.

These accessibility features were already in development during the alpha but were disabled for improvement. The team is committed to implementing them in the future and ensuring that they’re available from the start of the game. The goal is to make Windblown more accessible to a broader range of players, particularly those who may find the current combat mechanics challenging.

[h3]Collaboration with Dead Cells[/h3]

The team have discussed the possibility of incorporating elements from Dead Cells into Windblown, but they don’t want to overdo it or just include things for the sake of it. While there are ideas, such as the inclusion of absurd or funny weapons, the main goal is to focus on creating fun, unique weapons that fit the Windblown universe. The pan itself isn't a priority, but the concept of quirky weapons is central to the game. 

There is already a reference to Dead Cells in Windblown, in the form of the Intern skin players got for purchasing Windblown in it's opening weeks of launch. There is also the Death Orb which comes from Dead Cells. However, we don't want to saturate Windblown with references from other games and would prefer to add features that are unique, "silly" and enjoyable.

[h3]Game Release on Multiple Platforms[/h3]

Windblown is expected to be released on multiple platforms eventually, but this will likely happen after the Early Access phase. Currently, the game is focused on its PC release. The reason for waiting is that consoles do not allow Early Access games, and the certification process for consoles is lengthy. Once the Early Access period is complete and the game is polished, the team will look into porting Windblown to other platforms like consoles.

The team is also considering the possibility of crossplay across different platforms, as the game has been developed with crossplay in mind. However, certain platform restrictions, such as save sharing between consoles, may limit this feature. If it’s technically possible, the team plans to implement it, but this depends on the requirements and policies of different platforms.

[h3]Biome System and Passive Trinkets (e.g. Pets)[/h3]

The team are working on a biome system, and they’ve already taken a first step with a simple mechanic in the game where players can choose between two biomes. This is the "minimum viable version" of the concept, but they do plan to expand this to allow more meaningful choices during a run. The team wants to provide impactful decisions to players, that they can implement in Early Access. The idea is to have different paths or biomes to choose from, adding variety and replayability.

As for passive trinkets, such as pets, we actually prototyped some items and interactions, but had to postpone the full implementation to ensure we had more time to polish the Early Access launch. Now the game is out, we'll be looking at continuing work on things like this to see if they work with our vision for the game.

[h3]More Levels and DLC Plans[/h3]

The game is still in Early Access, and we're focused on expanding and polishing the core experience. There are plenty of ideas for new content, including additional levels, biomes, and features. However, the team emphasized that the current priority is improving the existing content and refining the core systems. 

Regarding paid DLC, the team is not considering it at this stage. They stated that any DLC plans are far in the future, after the Early Access period is over, and only if the content makes sense and adds meaningful value to the game. We're committed to delivering quality content without adding "empty" or meaningless features. The team also explained that they have no intention of introducing microtransactions for skins or other in-game items. For now, the focus is on creating a complete and polished game, and DLC is not a priority.

[h3]Customisation Options for Leapers and Weapons[/h3]

The team plans to add new skins to the game but aren’t sure about allowing players to customise leapers' outfits extensively. Changing outfits would be complicated, but we're exploring simpler customisation options, like colour changes for characters (similar to Among Us), and customisations for things like puke colour or dash trail colour. However, these ideas are still in early stages and aren't confirmed yet. 

The team is prioritising original skins and content over creating a full character editor, as the development team is small (only 8 core developers, with a few freelancers). They're focus is on adding new, fun creatures and skins rather than investing time in extensive customisation features. Since the team is small, they must make careful choices about what to prioritise, as they can't compete with larger teams.

[h3]Why Didn't You Use Kickstarter?[/h3]

The team chose not to pursue Kickstarter for Windblown because it would have required significant extra effort to prepare rewards and manage the campaign, which would have delayed development. Instead, they decided to focus on creating the game directly. While Dead Cells had a Kickstarter for its board game, Windblown didn’t need the same community-building strategy since it’s a video game and has the backing of Dead Cells to support development. The team preferred to avoid the extra work and focus their resources on the game itself.

[h3]What's Coming Next?[/h3]

The next big update will involve a revamp of the "Sudden Death" mechanic and balancing improvements. The team is currently working on new rewards for different difficulty levels, as well as refining mouse aiming. They’re also focusing on new weapons, trinkets, and a new biome. Biomes are complex additions, involving new environments, rules, and enemies, so creating a new one is a significant task that will take several months. 

Additionally, the team is working on addressing some multiplayer balancing issues. Players in multiplayer mode currently find the game too easy, even with the Sudden Death mechanic, and this will be adjusted. There's also a focus on improving user interface issues in multiplayer, such as making it easier to communicate without voice chat, especially during moments when players are crafting their builds together.

While there's no promise, the team may offer an alpha test branch in the future for players to test new features before they’re rolled out to everyone. This would be similar to the process used in Dead Cells for DLCs and updates. They’re also working on a system to deal with item dilution issues in roguelikes, where unlocking one item can reduce the chance of others appearing. The team plans to start with a simple solution, like a "ban" system for items, and then iterate based on player feedback.

[h3]Other Features and Improvements[/h3]

The team are focusing on refining the game’s core systems, with a strong emphasis on multiplayer balancing. They’ve already made several tweaks to enemy behaviour, especially regarding stun and freeze effects. There are also plans to improve the multiplayer experience by allowing players to join others in the middle of a run, merging the lines between single player and multiplayer for those that want it.

In the short term, they are working on addressing small but important issues, like fixing user interface bugs in multiplayer that hinder communication. The team is also planning new features for cooperative play, such as shared abilities like the Magi Fishes, and cooperative mechanics that feel more organic rather than adding a distinct "multiplayer mode."
